bio_paragraphs: "Started out building small games in GameMaker as a kid — then a friend taught me to write fake viruses in Visual Basic and showed me what real programming could do. That's when it really clicked."

Since then I've built a wide range of projects, both freelance and for myself, picking up web development and Roblox game development along the way. I currently work as a security guard at a nightclub, and get most of my coding done between shifts.
One project I'm especially proud of is RBX Native — check it out in Projects. I'm also quietly building something new that I'm planning to turn into my own company soon.
I'm comfortable shipping fast and iterating just as much as planning heavily upfront, and I'm equally happy solo-deving or collaborating with a team.
I've also gotten good at prompting AI tools like Claude to produce clean, maintainable code that's readable by both humans and other AI agents.
Outside of code I'm into music — mostly EDM (Virtual Riot, Chimes, Skybreak), but honestly open to anything: jazz, classical, jungle, reggae, shoegaze. Loathe is my current favorite band.

Dived deep into full-stack web development, mastering PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and later on Next.js and Vue.
Started scripting Roblox games using Luau, contributing to multiple projects and building custom tools.
Began taking on freelance projects, delivering web and game development work for various clients.
Balancing active development work with a role as a security guard in a nightclub, continuing to ship new projects.
